_comment: OPTIONAL. Claude Code workers only (grok, codex and agy have no Stop hook; they rely on orca-done.sh plus coordinator verify). Merge ONLY the "hooks" object into the worker's settings.json (e.g. $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json or <pane>/.claude/settings.local.json) and replace <SKILL_DIR> with the absolute path of the set-orchestrator skill directory. Delete this _comment key when copying. The hook blocks the turn from ending while a checklist whose "worker" equals $ORCA_TERMINAL_HANDLE is unfinished and has no done.json.
